title: Data-readiness findings contract (emerging market)
description: Array of data-quality findings on the emerging-market tables. Each finding identifies its affected records either by an explicit id sample (capped at 1,000) or by a structured selector evaluable against the as-delivered tables.

category.description: Free-text category label of your choosing (e.g. unit_scale, exposure, linkage, leakage, free_text, missingness).

affected_ids.description: Sample of affected identifiers (up to 1,000). If the affected set is larger, prefer affected_selector.

affected_selector.description: Structured filter identifying the affected records; conditions are ANDed; evaluable against the as-delivered table (column names and values as received, before cleaning).

value.description: Scalar for eq/ne/gt/gte/lt/lte/regex; array for in/not_in; [low, high] inclusive for between; omitted for is_null/not_null.

row_count_estimate.description: Total affected records (rows, claims, customers…) across the listed tables.

applies_to_test.description: True if the same issue is present in, or the same treatment was applied to, the test files.

action_taken.description: EXCLUDE: records removed. REPAIR: values corrected in place. RECONSTRUCT: values rebuilt from other information. CONSOLIDATE: records collapsed. RECLASSIFY: kept but reinterpreted/relabelled (e.g. normalised categories). NO_ACTION_FLAG_ONLY: left as-is and flagged.

action_detail.description: What was actually done: which records, corrected from what to what, what justified it.

triggered_by_rules.description: Playbook rule ids that led you to this finding. Empty array if you found it without a rule.

team_query.description: True if a human decision or confirmation is needed.
